governed.config: helm lint reads the chart (Chart.yaml, values.yaml and the templates) and nothing else; there is no separate configuration for the checks

suppressions.description: not honored: helm lint has no in-code suppression

en.label: helm lint (Helm charts)
en.purpose: Checks a Helm chart: a valid Chart.yaml, templates that render, and the structure and best practices the chart must follow.
en.limitation: It lints the chart at the project's root with its default values and does not fetch chart dependencies; it never installs anything into a cluster.
en.needs: Nothing beyond the tools image: no network and no project dependencies. It only applies to a project that has a Chart.yaml at its root.

pt-BR.label: helm lint (charts Helm)
pt-BR.purpose: Verifica um chart Helm: um Chart.yaml válido, templates que renderizam e a estrutura e as boas práticas que o chart deve seguir.
pt-BR.limitation: Verifica o chart na raiz do projeto com seus valores padrão e não baixa as dependências do chart; nunca instala nada em um cluster.
pt-BR.needs: Nada além da imagem de ferramentas: sem rede e sem dependências do projeto. Só se aplica a um projeto com um Chart.yaml na raiz.
